sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
causes: Low pressure switch stuck closed on a heat call longer than 150 seconds
Vent or combustion-air inducer restricted or not operating
diySteps: With the furnace off, look at the outdoor intake and exhaust terminations for snow, ice, leaves or a nest. Do not take the vent apart, and do not jumper the switch

Technician: check whether the low pressure switch is stuck closed on a heat call longer than 150 seconds, measure operating pressure in inches of water column, and inspect the vent and the combustion-air inducer
proAdvice: E224 is a low pressure switch failed closed, not E223 (failed open). The code resumes normal operation only after the fault is cleared. Do not jumper the switch. Call a licensed HVAC technician if the terminations are clear and the code returns.
